morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，无词缀变化。保留输入的音节字段 suap；标准清晰读音中 u、a 分属两个音节。派生 menyuap 时，meN- 遇词首 s，s 脱落并发生鼻音替换：meN- + suap → menyuap。

senses.zh_definition: 一次送入口中的食物量；一口食物。
senses.en_definition: An amount of food put into the mouth at one time; a mouthful.
senses.ms_definition: Kuantiti makanan yang dimasukkan ke dalam mulut sekali makan.
senses.nuances: 着重一次入口的分量，可由手或餐具送入口中；不固定等于一汤匙。

senses.zh_definition: 为换取不正当便利而给予或收受的贿赂，尤指钱财。
senses.en_definition: A bribe, especially money offered or received for improper favour.
senses.ms_definition: Wang sogokan yang diberikan atau diterima untuk memperoleh layanan tidak wajar.
senses.nuances: wang suap 指贿款；makan suap 指收受贿赂，不能按字面理解为吃饭。[DBP：suap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=suap)。

senses.zh_definition: 把食物送入口中；给人喂食。
senses.en_definition: To put food into someone's mouth; to feed someone.
senses.ms_definition: Memasukkan makanan ke dalam mulut sendiri atau orang lain.
senses.nuances: 裸词形常用于命令或口语；完整主动陈述通常用 menyuap。是否给自己或别人喂食由宾语与语境确定。

senses.zh_definition: 向某人行贿，以换取不正当便利。
senses.nuances: 裸词形主要见于口语和命令；正式主动句通常用 menyuap。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua kakitangan diingatkan supaya tidak menerima wang suap daripada pembekal.
dual_scenarios.zh: 提醒全体员工不得收受供应商的贿款。
dual_scenarios.en: All staff are reminded not to accept bribes from suppliers.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tolong suap adik dulu, ya. Saya nak bancuh susu kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tolong suap adik dahulu. Saya hendak membancuh susu sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 先帮忙喂一下弟弟妹妹哦，我去冲个奶。
dual_scenarios.en: Please feed the little one first. I'll just make some milk.
spoken_features: kejap 对应 sebentar；bancuh 在口语主动句中省略 meN-

messages.speaker: Farah (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Amir, tolong suap adik dulu, ya. Saya nak bancuh susu kejap.
messages.ms_standard: Amir, tolong suap adik dahulu. Saya hendak membancuh susu sebentar.
messages.zh: 阿米尔，先帮忙喂一下小的哦，我去冲个奶。
messages.en: Amir, please feed the little one first. I'll just make some milk.

messages.speaker: Amir (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh. Dia dah makan dua suap je, lepas tu tak nak dah.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Dia baru makan dua suap sahaja, kemudian tidak mahu makan lagi.
messages.zh: 行。他才吃了两口，之后就不肯吃了。
messages.en: Sure. He's only had two mouthfuls and won't eat any more.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places an ordinary mouthful beside the figurative sense of a bribe. It also records bersuap-suapan for exchanging mouthfuls, including between newlyweds during the bersanding ceremony. These recorded uses connect the word with nourishment, affection and improper inducement. The connection is a cultural reading of its meanings; it does not establish when the bribery sense arose. [DBP: suap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=suap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 su-ap 两拍配上手送食物入口的动作：一送是一口；若送的是钱，就联想到 wang suap。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈喂食时语气通常中性或亲切；请求别人帮忙可加 tolong、ya。指称别人 makan suap 带有严重指控意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 照护孩子、长者或病人时适用喂食义，应尊重对方意愿。新闻或工作文件谈贿赂时，宜明确行为与证据，避免用玩笑口吻给具体人物贴标签。
